# netsdk `show ip interface` samples

`cisco_ios_show_ip_interface_tunnel_vrf.raw` was written for
networktocode/ntc-templates#2378 from the Tunnel5001 block of the upstream
`cisco_ios_show_ip_interface.raw`, with documentation addresses: an
interface in VRF UNDERLAY, a global tunnel with `tunnel vrf UNDERLAY`, and a
tunnel in VRF OVERLAY with `tunnel vrf UNDERLAY`.
